workflows.name: Billing › Xero token › Refresh
workflows.summary: Keeps the stored Xero OAuth token alive by refreshing it before it expires.

steps.label: Load stored Xero token
steps.detail: Reads the current refresh token from the xero_tokens table.

steps.label: Call Xero: refresh token
steps.detail: POSTs to Xero's OAuth token endpoint with the refresh_token grant.

steps.label: Store refreshed token
steps.detail: Writes the new access/refresh token pair and expiry back to xero_tokens.

workflows.name: Sales › Lead › Qualify from email reply
workflows.summary: Reads a reply on a lead's email thread and lets Claude decide whether the lead is qualified.

trigger.detail: reply on a lead's email thread

steps.label: Fetch email thread
steps.detail: Pulls the latest message on the thread via Microsoft Graph.

steps.label: Classify intent + qualify
steps.detail: Claude decides qualified / needs_info / not_interested with a confidence score.

ai.model_rule: auto-newest Haiku, escalates to Sonnet below 0.7 confidence
ai.prompt_text: You are triaging an inbound reply on a sales lead's email thread. Decide one of: qualified, needs_info, not_interested. Reply with JSON only: {"decision": ..., "confidence": 0.0-1.0, "reason": "one sentence"}.
context_injected: whether the sender matches an existing contact record (yes/no)
the plain-text body of the latest reply only

steps.label: Update lead status
steps.detail: Writes the decision + confidence back onto the lead record.

steps.label: Now card: New lead
steps.detail: Surfaces a card on the sales team's Now page for a qualified lead.

workflows.name: Monitoring › Zabbix alert › Triage
workflows.summary: Turns an inbound Zabbix webhook into a case, once the monitoring gate confirms it's a live, non-flapping device.

steps.label: Parse Zabbix payload
steps.detail: Validates and normalises the incoming alert payload.

steps.label: Monitoring gate
steps.detail: enabled + not paused + not flapping (>20 alarms/week auto-disables).

steps.label: Create or append case
steps.detail: Opens a new case, or appends to the existing one for a non-resetting alarm.

steps.label: Push web alert
steps.detail: Web-push notification to the on-call staff.

steps.label: Skip (not monitored)
steps.detail: Device is disabled, paused, or flap-guarded — alert is dropped, no case raised.
